name: Low Noise Factory
description: Low Noise Factory is a Swedish manufacturer of cryogenic low-noise microwave amplifiers, founded as a spin-off from Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg. The company's ultra-sensitive amplifiers operate near absolute zero and are used in quantum computing readout chains, radio astronomy, and space exploration. Low Noise Factory's products have become a backbone component for superconducting qubit measurement setups worldwide.
